title: Quality-Conditioned Agreement in Automated Short Answer Scoring: Mid-Range Degradation and the Impact of Task-Specific Adaptation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Manhattan distance (L1-distance) between AI model scores and human expert gold-standard scores, stratified across the entire spectrum of response quality (from 0 to 10 correct categories) to identify differential measurement errors, specifically evaluating mid-range degradation.
